x: Such an occasion could not pass without celebration and a surprise party for Tom and Ethel was held at Belgrave Hall in August when Bill Merryman presented Tom and Ethel with momentos of a happy anniversary.

There can be nobody better known to all Belgravians than our Tom and the debt we owe was only partly recognised in 1980 when we held a special '50 Anniversary Party' for him and of course Ethel who too has supported us for all this time.

We were delighted to see President Tom Carter and Ethel at our British League home fixture in August. Ethel is making a rapid recovery following a stroke earlier in the year which required a brief period of hospitalisation.

A hearty vote of thanks was given to Tom Carter for all his work during a year of office made particularly difficult by Ethel's illness.
